purpose: M49.G8 evidence-producer register: every identity in verify-honesty.ts's REQUIRED_EVIDENCE must be produced by a gate that RUNS in the battery, because an unwired producer's artifact is silently overwritten by whoever runs next (the F7/F8/F9 collision of 2026-09-12) and then goes stale forever. A row here is an explicit, shrinking admission that one identity is knowingly outside the battery, with the reason and the ledger id that owns the fix. G8 fails on an unregistered unwired producer and on a ghost row.

unwiredRequired.reason: Wired-run verdict is not yet trustworthy: the gate's first execution outside a legacy artifact reports 5 languages failing on 24 dead literals, and per-language adjudication (which literals are genuinely unreachable vs. which the grammar enumeration misses) is unfinished. Its own `specTypes` defect was found and fixed in W8 (built but never read); that fix did not change the outcome, so the remaining list is real work, not a stale artifact. Wiring it now would gate every release on an unadjudicated verdict.

notes: M14.0.F6's committed artifact was `__LEGACY__` (pre-#761) with all-pass checks, so verify-honesty.ts's F6 deep-check has been validating a pre-lineage artifact. The W8 run replaces it with the gate's honest current output (5 non-passing languages).
Rows may only be removed by fixing the producer (wire it) or by resolving the reason. This register is not a place to park a red gate.
